name: Kalshi Bot — Levels
description: The Kalshi trading system as one multi-level map. The root shows the major systems; zoom into a system to see how it works inside.

elements.name: Kalshi exchange
intent: The venue. Everything else in this diagram exists to decide what to send it.

elements.name: Market & weather data feeds
intent: Detail: kalshi-bot-research-data.json

elements.name: LLM APIs
intent: No LLM sits in the trading decision path — cognition is for the evo fleet only.

elements.name: Railway main worker

properties.responsibility: One cycle loop: scan, trade, collect, run Experiment OS boot hooks

intent: The only writer to production data.

elements.name: Railway evo worker

properties.responsibility: Hosts the agent fleet

intent: Separate worker so agent cognition can never stall the trading cycle.

elements.name: Trading pipeline

properties.responsibility: scan → candidate → risk → paper / live / twin

intent: Where every order intent is born and gated.

elements.name: Research collectors

properties.responsibility: Ride-along data collection for books that do not exist yet

intent: Collection is decoupled from trading: the dataset accumulates before any book trades on it.

elements.name: Evolutionary agent fleet

properties.responsibility: LLM agents that propose and run their own books under budget

intent: Agents get no exemption from registration, gates or the arming ritual.

elements.name: Kalshi order entry
intent: Mirror of the exchange, drawn separately so the money-spending edge is legible.

elements.name: Postgres — single writer

properties.data: market record, trading record, research inputs, Experiment OS schema

intent: Every path into it that is not the worker is read-only by construction.

properties.responsibility: Operator views of books, positions and live state

elements.name: Experiment OS

properties.responsibility: Lifecycle, gates, enforcement, platform revisions, issues

intent: Canonical for experiment truth. Docs and chat are not authoritative once this can answer the same question.

elements.name: Operator + agent sessions

properties.role: owner of the real money and of every write that is not the worker's

intent: North star: $100/month realized profit.
Detail: kalshi-bot-control-plane.json

elements.name: Ops channel
intent: The agent sandbox cannot reach Railway or Postgres; this is the whole route in.

elements.name: Kalshi exchange
intent: Order books are resting bids only — the YES ask is derived as 100 − best NO bid.

elements.name: Fail-closed config

properties.responsibility: Settings, credentials, book/variant specs, risk caps

intent: Bad config means the worker does nothing trade-like, rather than proceeding on defaults.
Every book's universe and knobs are parsed and validated here before a cycle runs.

elements.name: Kalshi client

properties.responsibility: RSA-PSS signing, retries, fail-closed auth

intent: Single choke point for exchange credentials.

elements.name: Scanner

properties.responsibility: Fetch, compute liquidity metrics, score deterministically

intent: A fetch failure is recorded as a failure — never inferred as an empty universe.

elements.name: Market record

properties.data: markets, snapshots, order books, signals, candidate ticks

intent: The tape every replay and backtest is graded against.

elements.name: Strategy books

properties.families: mmsell, theta, weather, freeze, pin15, tfav, wcprop, xgame

intent: Parallel tags against the same tape, so P&L is comparable head-to-head.
A book is a question, not a product: proving one is −EV is a win.

elements.name: Universe filter

properties.filters: only= / skip= (raw tickers), mtype= / mode= / xmtype= (taxonomy)

intent: A series with no taxonomy entry is admitted by NO allowlist filter — classification debt shows up as exclusion.

elements.name: Candidate

properties.dataType: market × book × cycle, with the entry rule's edge attached

intent: The one object paper, live and twin all share.

elements.name: Evidence funnel

properties.responsibility: Names the stage where a book's count first hit zero

intent: Distinguishes 'saw no markets' from 'was never asked' without reading raw logs.

elements.name: Risk manager

properties.gates: kill switch, mode, balance, spread, liquidity, closes-soon, per-market + total exposure, daily loss

intent: Fail-closed: refuses on any doubt.
Never weakened to make a task easier.

elements.name: Paper engine

properties.responsibility: Simulate at the real quote, model fees, manage exits, settle 0/100

intent: Edge is measured against the price actually paid, so the spread is netted out.
Its one structural lie: it assumes a resting maker order always fills.

elements.name: Live executor
intent: Three independent conditions, plus a recorded arming — never one flag.

elements.name: Paper twin

properties.responsibility: Fresh paper book on live parameters, started at the same instant

intent: Controls sample, regime, sizing and concurrency so the only difference left is the fill assumption.

elements.name: Trading record

properties.data: paper_trades, positions, live_orders, fills, twin + parity events

intent: Paper and live sit side by side, so the twin comparison is a query.

elements.name: Kalshi order entry
intent: Mirror of the exchange so the money-spending edge stays legible.

elements.name: NWS
intent: Free, needs a user agent. Also the settlement source for the temperature markets.

elements.name: Open-Meteo
intent: Ensembles give an empirical P(bucket) — the market prices a distribution, not a point.

elements.name: Polymarket
intent: Reference prices only. Station must match or it is a different bet, not a mispricing.

elements.name: Kalshi archives + tape
intent: The only way to get sample before live collection accumulates.

elements.name: Weather collector

properties.collects: forecasts, HRRR, intraday observations, ensembles, bucket ladders, settlements

intent: Throttled and fail-soft: a provider outage skips the weather books and disturbs nothing else.

properties.collects: rolling spot window + near-settlement ladder snapshots with the model probability

elements.name: Cross-venue tape collector

properties.collects: matched Kalshi/Polymarket game markets, both trade tapes

intent: Collect only — no trading. Precision over recall: ambiguous matches are dropped.

properties.bounded: a chunk per cycle, newest settlements first

properties.data: forecasts, observations, ensembles, bucket snapshots, settlements

elements.name: polymarket_snapshots
intent: Kept apart from the Kalshi tables so provenance is never ambiguous.

elements.name: backfill_weather_*
intent: Separate from live-collected tables: an analysis always knows whether a price was observed or reconstructed.

elements.name: weather_forecast_outcomes

properties.data: one labeled row per intraday cycle, replayed at settlement with no lookahead

intent: The persisted validation dataset — skill accumulates instead of being rebuilt ad hoc.

properties.reports: P&L by book/window, forecast vs market, consistency

elements.name: weather_model_check

properties.asks: does the ensemble beat the market's own implied distribution?

intent: The gate before any real edge book: Brier / log-loss / cost-aware trades.

elements.name: weather_exit_sweep

properties.asks: should the books hold to settlement?

intent: Replays every settled trade under a grid of TP/SL exits — a paired comparison live books would need months to approximate.

properties.builds: ~10-second bars from both venues' own timestamps

elements.name: Graded verdict
intent: Read-only analyses inform a verdict; they never are one.

elements.name: Experiment OS gate
intent: Only a recorded evaluator PASS turns collected data into a book.

elements.name: Strategy books
intent: A dataset earns a book only after it beats the market on settled events.

elements.name: LLM APIs

properties.routing: aliases, not hardcoded models: routine vs deep

intent: No API key means cognition fails closed: listeners, marks and settlements keep running, heartbeats journal as skipped.

elements.name: Cost + token ceilings

properties.limits: weekly per-agent spend, per-heartbeat tokens, weekly agent tokens

intent: Enforced BEFORE each call; exceeding one degrades the heartbeat to no_llm bookkeeping rather than stopping the fleet.

elements.name: Evo orchestrator
intent: Computes due heartbeat slots deterministically, so a restart recomputes identical schedules.

elements.name: Heartbeat

properties.shape: wake → load → retrieve → reason (ONE LLM call) → act → journal → sleep

intent: One call per heartbeat means no agent-side loop — runaway recursion is impossible by construction.

elements.name: Listeners
intent: Cheap deterministic watchers that trigger a wake between scheduled slots.

elements.name: Research reads

properties.reads: thesis docs, BOOK_REGISTRY, live book performance, peer journals

intent: What the fleet can see of the operator's own strategies — the reason a new book must be published to them.

elements.name: Strategy sandbox
intent: Test a rule before spending a paper position on it.

elements.name: Memory + peer learning
intent: Journals are structural and machine-checkable, so quality is scoreable rather than asserted.

elements.name: Historical search
intent: Replay only, no live path, and no lifecycle of its own (DEC-003).

elements.name: Experiment OS registration
intent: An agent's tag is refused at the write path like any other unregistered tag.

elements.name: Shared paper engine
intent: The same engine the operator books use — fees, depth-capped entries, settlement at 0/100.

elements.name: Security boundary
intent: Evo runs under BOT_MODE=evo and place_order self-guards on mode + kill switch — there is no live-order path from the fleet.

elements.name: Agent trades + opportunities

properties.data: evo paper trades, ex-ante evo_opportunities (declared universes)

intent: Opportunities are logged BEFORE the fact, so post-hoc redefinition of what an agent could have caught is impossible.

elements.name: Fitness score

properties.weights: profit 35 · consistency 20 · risk 15 · evidence 10 · forecast 10 · adaptive 10

intent: Bayesian shrinkage toward zero at small n — lottery outcomes get limited credit.
Integrity failures are penalised separately from shared-infrastructure failures.

elements.name: Retirement — bottom 30%
intent: Retired is permanently inactive, never deleted: identity, genomes, trades and the terminal reflection stay queryable.

elements.name: Reproduction — top 30%
intent: Every 4th cohort swaps one child slot for a wildcard founder, so the population cannot converge on one lineage.

elements.name: Graveyard + lineage
intent: Prior failures are a readable corpus, not deleted history.

elements.name: Capability tickets

properties.dedup: token-set similarity — duplicates become supporters of the existing ticket

intent: The fleet asks for capabilities it lacks instead of inventing unsafe workarounds.

elements.name: Evo Ticket Workshop
intent: A human session actions or rejects each request and closes what was already delivered.

elements.name: Experiment

properties.responsibility: Asks exactly one question

intent: The central domain object. Everything else hangs off it.

elements.name: Version

properties.responsibility: Freezes the scientific contract: rules, universe, risk envelope, declared arm set

intent: A changed question is a NEW Version, never an edited one.
Narrowing a frozen arm set or risk envelope is a successor Version (DEC-004).

elements.name: Epoch

properties.responsibility: A changed world under the same question — taxonomy expansion, candidate-population change

intent: Evidence never pools across a boundary Experiment OS declares non-poolable.

elements.name: Deployment + arm

properties.responsibility: Binds one arm of a Version to a strategy tag

intent: The only thing that grants a tag permission to trade at all.

elements.name: Strategy tag

properties.example: one tag per arm; live and twin tags are separate

intent: A tag not registered to an active deployment arm cannot write.

elements.name: Enforcement (NEW_ONLY)
intent: Refused, not warned about.
Existing books are grandfathered but may not silently gain arms or change rules.

elements.name: Books trading under the tag
intent: Paper, live canary or production — the stage decides which.

elements.name: Evidence

properties.data: paper + live trades, fills, twin parity, funnel counts

intent: Accumulated per arm and per epoch, never pooled across a broken boundary.

elements.name: Pre-registered gate

properties.approvalCriteria: a recorded verdict on a gate registered before results were seen

intent: Gates decide promotions, not P&L. HOLD on thin sample is correct.
Automatic evaluation is allowed; automatic promotion never is.

elements.name: Recorded transition

properties.responsibility: The only thing that moves a stage or changes exposure

intent: Never a side effect of merging code. A dry run authorizes nothing.
Only a recorded evaluator PASS authorizes it — a hand-written or stale PASS never does.

elements.name: Platform revision

properties.scope: fees, fills, taxonomy, execution, risk, provenance, metric definitions

intent: A change to shared semantics silently invalidates evidence, so it is recorded like an experiment.

elements.name: Impact disposition
intent: Every affected active experiment must be dispositioned before the revision activates.

elements.name: Issue

properties.responsibility: Durable state for an anomaly, defect, incident or open question

intent: Routes work to the role that already owns the surface — there is no fixer role.
Never changes a lifecycle state, gate or exposure as a side effect.

elements.name: Owning role
intent: Detail: kalshi-bot-control-plane.json

elements.name: Operator
intent: The only party that can expand real-money exposure.

elements.name: Agent session (Claude)

properties.sandbox: cannot reach Railway, Postgres or most third-party APIs

intent: Reads everything through the ops channel; writes only through a PR or the audited envelope.

elements.name: Session role
intent: An architectural constraint, not documentation: a read-only role that finds a needed write recommends the owning role.

elements.name: ops/request.json
intent: Shared and single-slot: concurrent sessions overwrite each other, so always use a unique id.

elements.name: GitHub Actions runner
intent: A change on a feature branch cannot be exercised against production until it merges.

elements.name: Read-only analyses
intent: Stdlib-only because the runner cannot import the worker package.

elements.name: Postgres — SELECT-only role

properties.enforcement: server-side; no writable path may be added

intent: The ops channel is read-only against production by design.

elements.name: ops/results/<id>.txt
intent: Poll for your own per-id result, not the shared pointer. Budget minutes.

elements.name: Pull request

properties.responsibility: The handoff — never chat

intent: Reviewed change is how a session alters production behavior.

elements.name: Default branch
intent: What the runner executes and what Railway deploys — one code path, no drift.

elements.name: Production-write envelope
intent: Three disjoint transports on purpose — never one shared vocabulary (DEC-005).
Strictly validated, consumed once at boot against a durable receipt.

elements.name: Worker boot
intent: Only the worker holds a writable DATABASE_URL, so registering a Version is necessarily an operator action.

connections.label: real orders
intent: The only edge here that spends money.

connections.label: promote / pause / retire
intent: The feedback loop the whole system is built around: evidence decides which books keep running.

connections.label: write envelope
intent: Consumed once at the worker's next boot — agents never write directly.

connections.label: all gates
intent: The gate that stops live is recorded, not just enforced — it is evidence for the parity study.

connections.label: only a PASS wires a book
children join the next cohort
intent: The evolutionary loop: fitness decides who reproduces, and the population turns over weekly.

connections.label: arms / pauses the tag
intent: The loop that closes the system: evidence decides which tags keep trading.

connections.label: moves the stage
intent: Promotion PAPER → LIVE_CANARY is the transition that costs real money.

metadata.layout: left-to-right rank grid; hub nodes may be mirrored (see properties.mirrorOf)
metadata.altitude: root: subsystems; each service zooms into its own level
